answer: Because the marble derivation is checked against the inlet nonce, the atlas audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 45 aliases produces 45 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 11 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
